purpose: Digest-pinned identification of the Rust crates observed compiling for the librsvg-c static library inside the redistributed @img/sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 1.3.3 combined binary, with a conservative target-set approximation from the retained librsvg 2.62.91 Cargo.lock and recipe edits. Every observed compile event is bound to the retained historical job log; two previously approximated, still lock-reachable crates remain unobserved. Observed compilation is distinct from incorporation into the shipped binary; this is explicitly partial, not a corresponding-source offer, and not legal clearance.

npmProvenanceAttestation.statement: Binds the shipped npm tarball bytes to one GitHub Actions run of the pinned commit. It does not enumerate compiled crates.

cargoInvocation.featureNotes: cargo_wrapper.py adds 'avif' only when libdav1d is found and 'pixbuf' only when gdk-pixbuf is found; the recipe builds neither (-Dpixbuf{,-loader}=disabled; dav1d is not built), so librsvg-c is built with no explicit features.

resolvedForTargetApproximation.detail: Conservative 2026-09-09 target-set approximation: all 159 registry crates observed compiling in the retained librsvg phase, plus rustc_version 0.4.1 and semver 1.0.28 carried from the earlier approximation only after verifying their unchanged checksums and reachability in the new Cargo.lock. All selected archives are checksum-verified. Normal/build dependency declarations are rechecked against each archive Cargo.toml and pinned lock edges; proc-macro is read from lib.proc-macro. These role labels are not a linkage classification. Cargo feature unification and target selection were not rerun, so this is not an independently resolved feature graph and cannot establish the absence of unlogged dependencies.

compiledInHistoricalBuild.detail: Observed compile events in retained job log of run 32944387969 job 98102057009 (raw sha256 ab557d76…): 159 registry crates plus two workspace packages. Bound per item as provenanceStatus compiled-per-build-log with log line and timestamp. Observed compilation is not a resolved feature graph, does not authenticate every source byte independently of the checksummed archives, and does not establish incorporation into the shipped dylib.

incorporatedIntoShippedBinary.detail: librsvg-c is built with fat LTO, codegen-units=1, opt-level=z and linked with -Wl,-dead_strip; proc-macro and build-only crates are never linked, and any normal crate may be wholly or partly eliminated. The retained compile log is not a linkage map; no binary inspection was performed and strings alone would not prove inclusion.

unretained.detail: The retained job log supplies observed Compiling events for the librsvg phase (159 registry crates and two workspace packages). No explicit truncation, cache-hit or Fresh markers were found, but that does not prove silent reuse or unlogged activity was impossible, and the log does not enumerate the resolved feature graph.

The conservative 161-crate target set contains every observed registry crate and two still-lock-reachable prior approximation members (rustc_version 0.4.1, semver 1.0.28) that were not observed. Those two remain resolved-approximation. Cargo feature unification and target selection were not rerun; this is not a complete feature graph or proof that unlogged dependencies are absent. Normal/build/proc-macro labels describe checked declarations, not surviving linked code.
Fat LTO and dead-stripping mean the set of crates whose code survives in libvips-cpp.8.18.6.dylib is a subset of the compiled set and is not established here.

Six crates (block 0.1.6, malloc_buf 0.0.6, mutants 0.0.4, objc-foundation 0.1.1, objc_id 0.1.1, selectors 0.40.0) carry no licence text member in their .crate archive (noticeStatus no-licence-text-in-crate). Config/SharpLibvipsRustNoticeMaterials.json records the version-bound upstream investigation for each: mutants and selectors have exact external notice material retained under Resources/ThirdPartyLicenses/sharp-libvips-1.3.3/rust/ (labelled external; never archive members), while the four Steven Sheldon crates remain unresolved because neither their archives nor their tagged upstream revisions publish any licence text or copyright statement.
librsvg and librsvg-c (LGPL-2.1-or-later) are covered by the librsvg archive and its COPYING.LIB notice in Config/ThirdPartyBinaryProvenance.json; they are not registry crates and are not items here.

MPL-2.0 crates carry a source-availability obligation for their own files, and Unicode-3.0 crates carry notice requirements; the .crate files pinned here are the exact source of those crates, but how they are made available is an owner/legal decision, not established by this manifest.
